description: Reproduce, then fix or document, the browser-only internal server error on https://omniroute.celestium.life/dashboard/cache. The planner already established that with the Bearer management key, headless Chromium loads /dashboard/cache with 200 and the Prompt Cache, Semantic Cache, and Reasoning Replay tabs all render with no pageerror. The only console errors were unrelated (news.json CORS, wss://...:20132/live-ws refused). The real browser authenticates with the httpOnly auth_token cookie: an HS256 JWT {authenticated:true, jti, exp}, signed with the pod env JWT_SECRET by POST /api/auth/login or OIDC (src/shared/utils/dashboardSessionToken.ts). The difference is therefore likely the cookie-session path, a client-side exception that only shows in that state, or stale assets. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: Mint a short-lived dashboard session token INSIDE the pod, never printing JWT_SECRET: `kubectl -n omniroute exec deploy/omniroute -- node -e` with a script that resolves jose (try require('jose'), then a createRequire from the app dir, e.g. /app/node_modules) and prints only `await new SignJWT({authenticated:true}).setProtectedHeader({alg:'HS256'}).setIssuedAt().setJti(crypto.randomUUID()).setExpirationTime('1h').sign(new TextEncoder().encode(process.env.JWT_SECRET))`. Save the output to /tmp/omr-session.token with chmod 600. If jose cannot be resolved or JWT_SECRET is unset in the pod, call send_message with severity 'warning' asking the user to provide their browser's auth_token cookie value (DevTools > Application > Cookies) or the dashboard password, and wait.

Write a throwaway Playwright script in /tmp that requires /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/OmniRoute/node_modules/playwright, launches with executablePath '/Users/celes/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1243/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell', and adds the cookie { name: 'auth_token', domain: 'omniroute.celestium.life', path: '/', secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'Lax' } with NO Authorization header. Log pageerror (message plus stack), console errors, and every response with status 400 or higher (including _next/static chunks and RSC ?_rsc= requests). Scenarios: (a) page.goto /dashboard/cache with waitUntil 'load', wait 5s, then click 'Semantic Cache' and 'Reasoning Replay'; (b) page.reload(); (c) goto /dashboard/analytics, then client-side navigate to /dashboard/cache (sidebar link href '/dashboard/cache' from src/shared/constants/sidebarVisibility/sections.ts, or Quick nav). Capture the body text and a screenshot for each. At the same time, run `kubectl -n omniroute logs deploy/omniroute --since=10m | grep -iE 'error|cache|unhandled'`.

If the error reproduces, map the stack trace or failing URL to source: src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/cache/page.tsx, components/CacheEntriesTab.tsx, components/ReasoningCacheTab.tsx, the /api/cache* routes, or the dashboard layout. Determine the root cause.

If it is a small local fix: implement it and add a regression test at the lowest layer that fails without it. Use Vitest in src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/cache/__tests__/ (extend CachePage.test.tsx or add a new file) for render bugs, or node:test in tests/unit/api/ for route bugs. Run the focused tests, eslint on the changed files, and npm run check:dashboard-typecheck. Commit locally as 'fix(dashboard): <root cause> on /dashboard/cache'. If it is not small, or does not reproduce even with a cookie session, change no code.
Cleanup: POST https://omniroute.celestium.life/api/auth/logout with the minted cookie to revoke its jti, then delete /tmp/omr-session.token and the /tmp scripts and screenshots.

Write /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/menagerie/.agents/tasks/usage-chart-legend/cache-500-findings.md. Include: the auth mode used; the exact error, stack, and failing URL (or 'not reproduced' with the scenarios tried); pod log excerpt; root cause or the leading hypothesis; and what was changed and committed, or the recommended next step.
acceptance_criteria: cache-500-findings.md exists and records auth mode (cookie session), scenarios tried, captured errors/URLs, and root cause or hypothesis

If a fix was made: a regression test fails without it and passes with it; npx vitest run on the cache __tests__ (or node:test file) passes; eslint 0 errors on changed files; check:dashboard-typecheck no regression; committed locally
Minted session revoked via /api/auth/logout and temp token/scripts deleted; JWT_SECRET and the management key never printed
findings: Not reproduced; no code change, no commit. Cookie-session auth (in-pod minted 1h HS256 auth_token via node crypto since jose is bundled; accepted 200 vs 401 without; revoked via /api/auth/logout -> 401 after; temp files deleted; secrets never printed). Scenarios (a) load + Semantic/Reasoning tabs, (b) reload, (c) analytics -> sidebar client-nav: no pageerror, no console errors, no >=400 responses (only aborted /dashboard?_rsc prefetches). SSR with NEXT_LOCALE for all 67 locales: 200. /api/cache, /stats, /entries, /reasoning: 200, payload well-formed. Pod (up 9h, 0 restarts, RS 13:48Z) 10h log: no level 50/60, nothing for cache routes. Traefik: no cache 5xx; unrelated: http router references missing middleware default-redirectscheme@kubernetescrd so http:// returns 404. Hypothesis: transient error during one of today's 5 rollouts (pod not ready or deploy skew from a stale tab). Next step: capture failing URL/status/digest + kubectl logs immediately if it recurs. Verification: cache vitest 13/13 pass; check:dashboard-typecheck OK (within baseline). Details: .agents/tasks/usage-chart-legend/cache-500-findings.md
